# Teacher App OCR assets

- tesseract.min.js and worker.min.js are from the tesseract.js 5.1.1 npm package.
- The SIMD and non-SIMD LSTM cores are from the tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 npm package. Their WebAssembly is embedded.
- The English and Hindi models are the decompressed 4.0.0_best_int files from https://github.com/naptha/tessdata/tree/gh-pages/4.0.0_best_int.

These assets are distributed under Apache 2.0. See LICENSE.
